candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show paired 500 (order) and 502 (checkout) spans under the same correlation IDs, and gateway metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause inside order (db, payment, inventory) not established; logs excluded and no order-side telemetry admitted.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show order returning 500 to gateway checkout, producing 502s at the gateway. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The specific fault within order is not yet bounded by current evidence.
